headerSub: For learning & research only · Support the official version · Activate in 3 steps

poDesc:
No product selected = one code activates ALL products (full-suite mode)
Select specific products = activate only what you need

s1Desc: ja-netfilter is a local Java agent that lets your IDE accept a custom license code. It must be installed on your machine.
s1Tip: 💡 After downloading, unzip it to any folder (suggested: ~/ja-netfilter/) and remember the path — you will need it in the next step.
s2Title: Configure IDE VM Options (the most critical step)
m1Li3: Append one line to the end of the opened file (replace the path with your actual unzip path):
s2Warn:
⚠️ Common mistakes:
  • The path must be your actual unzip path — do not copy it verbatim
  • If the IDE fails to start, the path is wrong — delete the vmoptions file and start over
  • Fully quit and restart the IDE after editing
s3Title: Generate a license code & activate the IDE
s3NameLbl: Licensee name (shown on the IDE’s About page)
s3CopyHtml: 📋 Copy license code ✓ Copied
s3TipHtml:
🎯 Last step:
Open the IDE (make sure Step 2 is done) → the activation dialog appears → choose Activation code → paste → click Activate.

vmPath1:
# macOS/Linux users, run in Terminal:
echo -e '\n-javaagent:/your-path/ja-netfilter.jar' >> "$HOME/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/ProductName202x.x/ProductName.vmoptions"
vmPath2:
# Windows users, run in PowerShell:
Add-Content "$env:APPDATA\JetBrains\ProductName202x.x\ProductName.vmoptions" "`n-javaagent:C:\your-path\ja-netfilter.jar"
metaDescription: Unofficial JetBrains license generator for studying RSA signatures and Java agents locally in your browser. Product selection and configuration notes for learning and research.
